label: prf:colour-singlet-exterior-flavour-symmetric
title: Proof that colour-singlet q-exterior states are flavour q-symmetric
html: Each \check R_{i,i+1} acts on \varepsilon_q by -q^{-1}, so X_i(\varepsilon_q \otimes f) = \varepsilon_q \otimes (-q^{-1} B_i f). The (0,1,2) component of \varepsilon_q is 1, so \varepsilon_q \otimes g = \varepsilon_q \otimes h forces g = h. Hence X_i(\varepsilon_q \otimes f) = -\varepsilon_q \otimes f if and only if -q^{-1} B_i f = -f, that is B_i f = q f. For item 2, substitute B_1 f = -q^{-1} f: if q^{-2} = -1, then q^2 \cdot q^{-2} = 1 gives q^2 + 1 = 0, contradicting q^2 + 1 \neq 0.
heading: Proof
